name: claw-telegram
description: Claw mod: talk to Claw from your phone. Messages from your own Telegram chat start a turn, the answer is sent back, briefings and check-ins are pushed to you, and /approve on your phone unlocks one action that Claw Guard is holding.

bot_token.title: Telegram bot token
bot_token.description: From @BotFather. Stored in secure storage, never in settings.json.

chat_id.title: Your chat id
chat_id.description: Only messages from this chat are accepted. Leave empty, message your bot, and Claw tells you the id.

claw_dir.title: Claw folder
claw_dir.description: Folder with your Claw files. Must match the other Claw mods.

poll_seconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often to check Telegram for new messages.

forward_checkins.title: Push briefings and check-ins
forward_checkins.description: Send Claw Heartbeat briefings and check-ins to Telegram (skips 'nothing urgent').
